_comment: Copy this to data/taste.json (or point taste_file at it) and fill it with YOUR taste. This is the input the /recommend skill reasons over — it replaces the event-sourced 'ledger' the original pipeline read from. EVERYTHING except a couple of seed videos is optional; a minimal file is just `liked_video_ids` + `channels`. Delete the _comment keys.

rated._comment: One entry per video you've watched and formed an opinion on. Best-first is nice but not required. Only `title`/`rating` are really needed; the rest sharpens the skill's judgment.
rated.title: 散歩vlog: 早朝の京都・鴨川沿いを歩く
rated._axes_comment: Optional 1–5 sub-scores, each on its own vector — don't average them. topic_pull=did the subject grip me, presenter=did I enjoy this person, audio_fidelity=recording quality, speech_clarity=delivery (clean vs fast/slurred), difficulty=how hard to follow.
rated._axis_valid_comment: The censor: when a video was too hard to judge an axis fairly, mark that axis false so the skill ignores it. Classic case: understood-nothing content where presenter=5 is valid but topic_pull isn't.
rated._follow_comment: Per-channel intent, decoupled from the star. 'more' = keep this channel a strong seed even on a mediocre video. 'block' = never recommend it.
rated.note: calm early-morning walk, clear narration, exactly my speed

channels._comment: Channels you have an opinion on. follow_state ∈ more|neutral|less|block. `profile` is a free 'presenter fingerprint' the skill matches against to discover UNKNOWN similar channels.

profile.characterization: calm, clear, mid-register solo narrator; dry humor; unhurried

_derived_comment: The three lists below are auto-derived from `rated`/`channels` if you omit them. Provide them explicitly to override.
_watched_comment: Video ids you've already seen — harvested candidates matching these are dropped so they never get recommended back. Ids in `rated` are added automatically.
